decoding_rule: Subtract one from each group: stage, error tens, error units, detail tens, detail units.
interpretation: Assuming the five groups and colors were counted correctly, the diagnostic reported a vertical-retrace-status edge timeout in stage 4. Its encoding does not identify which of the six clear/set waits timed out or the sampled status values.
limits: This is a human-observed diagnostic code, not a Windows boot result or full causal diagnosis. LED and timer operations perturb timing, and their wall-clock duration is not guaranteed. Do not infer that a different attempt failed at the same phase.
